scenarios.title: Scenario 1: Central Spine Smoke Influx (PIE Overlap Demonstration)
scenarios.description: Electrical smoke alarm triggers in Central Corridor C. Sensor zones overlap across all five areas. PIE corrects a 26% overcounting error (200 → 148), preventing false exit bottleneck alerts.

scenarios.title: Scenario 2: Lab A Fire & Exit Load Diversion
scenarios.description: Chemical fire in Lab A. Zones A, B, and Corridor C share sensor overlaps. PIE corrects a 22.1% overcounting error (122 → 95), giving accurate exit load for safe routing.

scenarios.title: Scenario 3: Hick's Law Cognitive Decision Test (Threshold Live Switch)
scenarios.description: Auditorium E evacuation with hazard in Classroom D. The 3-turn shortcut is only 8.2% faster — rejected at the default 15% threshold. Slide the threshold to 8% or below to see the route decision switch to Optimal live.
